description.description: The description of the export (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: The description is for documentation purposes only and does not affect security.

dataset.description: The BigQuery dataset to write findings' updates to. Format: projects/[projectId]/datasets/[datasetId].
dataset.rationale: Exports must target approved, secure datasets. Using temporary or default datasets risks accidental exposure.

filter.description: Expression that defines which findings are exported. Should include severity conditions to prioritize critical issues.
filter.rationale: Without a proper filter, important findings may be missed or too much irrelevant data may be exported, weakening security analysis.

folder.description: Numerical ID of the parent folder where the BigQuery export is defined.
folder.rationale: Determines scope of the export but does not directly affect security posture.

big_query_export_id.description: A unique identifier for the BigQuery export within the folder.
big_query_export_id.rationale: Unique, descriptive export IDs help ensure correct configuration and prevent overwriting exports.
